title: Per-role model routing, more Orca agent IDs and Rive motion guidance for mobile
acceptance_criteria: Config accepts optional orca.role_models {role: {model, effort?}} for enabled roles with an explicit orca.role_agents entry; init writes it from repeatable --role-model ROLE=MODEL[:EFFORT].

Validation rejects a model for a CLI without Orca --model support, effort for OpenCode, unknown efforts, and roles that are unknown, disabled or lack an explicit CLI; legacy configs without role_models stay valid.
Worker specs, activation and smoke prompts render the resolved model/effort next to the CLI and the launch flags --model/--effort; nothing is rendered when no model is pinned.
orca.agent, orca.role_agents, init and activate accept the Orca agent IDs cursor and opencode2 in addition to claude, codex, antigravity and opencode.

Stack detection records Rive projects (rive.yaml at the root or one level down) with a `rive <dir> --verify` lint command; UI/UX and frontend role profiles document Rive CLI motion for mobile apps with human approval for push/publish.
Bundled skill versions and core.json are 0.1.6; README documents the 0.1.5 -> 0.1.6 upgrade without claiming a live Orca worker ran.
test_seams: Bootstrap CLI init, validate and activate, validate_config, detect_stack and rendered worker/activation/smoke prompts; tests do not start real agents, call Rive or mutate Orca.

documentation.assessment: Adds an optional config field and two agent IDs (compatible, schema 0.1 kept) and Rive guidance for mobile motion. Update README, ROLE-ASSIGNMENT and the setup skill. No application requirements, API/data contracts or deployment change; requirement IDs are not applicable. The user approved the proposal on 2026-10-26, authorizing the protected core.json version bump; scope must still report that protected path.

updates.change: Document orca.role_models, --role-model, new agent IDs, Rive detection and the 0.1.6 upgrade.
Document per-role model/effort routing and provider limits.
Offer per-role model/effort selection and the new CLI IDs.
